correctness.rationale: The frozen mathematical theorem is correct. In the Alexander dual all sets of size at most four are faces; a five-set is a face exactly when connected; deleting any vertex of a six-face leaves it connected, so minimum degree two and girth force a chordless six-cycle. Distinct hexagons cannot share a five-set (its endpoints and the two completing vertices would form a four-cycle), ruling out any seven-face. For a disconnected four-set F, two different connectors meet every component; joining the two neighbor pairs by paths in two components makes a simple cycle on at most six vertices. It must use all six, and a third connector would create two hexagons sharing five vertices. A nonhexagonal five-tree therefore has a private four-face by deleting a nonleaf. In each hexagon, collapse a root five-set with the hexagon, then pair each remaining five-set with a disconnected four-set indexed by its parent edge in a spanning tree of the complement cycle. At deletion only the child five-set is a live coface, and the extension lemma prevents interference even for overlapping hexagons. The residual at-most-three-dimensional complex is 2-connected by the full original three-skeleton and collapse. Its top homology is free as a subgroup of a free chain group with no incoming boundary. Hurewicz and Whitehead give the dual wedge. Integral combinatorial Alexander duality transfers the concentrated homology and the known complete two-skeleton for n>=10 permits the analogous homotopy upgrade on the original side. Independent replay at /workspace/branches/6411850d-4c29-467e-b38d-85e90dc8be4e/finite_reproduction.py checked live cofaces and exact counts on eight graphs: e.g. (c_5,h_6,B)=(24,3,105) for the overlapping theta graph, (252,28,491),(288,24,1101),(324,18,2074) for Heawood, Möbius–Kantor and Pappus. Direct mod-two Betti numbers for the first five examples match, which does not establish integral torsion-freeness. The frozen scripts were inspected, not executed. The repaired proof retains the verified construction and accurately separates the prior face/Euler inputs from the homotopy conclusion.
